description: Save up to 200 answers to an AI column, each with the `row` and `basis` next_ai_cells gave it. An answer outside the column's choices, or to a prompt that has since changed, comes back with a reason. Each value is saved as generated, with the instruction and `model`. Needs a token.

column.description: The AI column's id, from next_ai_cells

model.description: The model that answered, like the one you are

name: fill_ai_cells
